name: Homebrew Install
description: Install Homebrew and the distro prerequisites it needs for a named non-root user, then optionally remove the manager checkout and default cache artifacts.

username.description: Named non-root passwd user that should own the temporary Homebrew tree while Homebrew is installed.

cache_directory.description: Directory used for Homebrew bootstrap downloads and bottle caches. Point this at a persistent path if you want to reuse the cached installer and bottles between runs.

cleanupHomebrew.description: Remove the Homebrew manager and default cleanup artifacts after bootstrap. Leave this false when you want the feature to keep a working Homebrew install.
